title: Lemonade Policy Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lemonade:policy
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(policy_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Lemonade policy events land each day and how many distinct policy type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Lemonade policy records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct policy type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much Lemonade policy activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
